rows.note: Use this for paper used to wrap gifts or other items.

example.english: This wrapping paper is pretty; it’s just right for wrapping a gift.
example.traditional: 呢張包裝紙好靚，包禮物啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 baau1 zong1 zi2 hou2 leng3 baau1 lai5 mat6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use this general term when the wrapping material may be paper, plastic, or another substance.

example.english: When shipping goods, choose the right wrapping materials; cardboard boxes and bubble wrap both work.
example.traditional: 寄貨嗰陣，要揀啱包裝材料，紙箱同氣泡紙都得。
example.jyutping: gei3 fo3 go2 zan6 jiu3 gaan2 ngaam1 baau1 zong1 coi4 liu6 zi2 soeng1 tung4 hei3 paau3 zi2 dou1 dak1
